name: lawbar-desktop
description: First UI shell — Electron app + theme-token foundation. Token-compliance fixture only; NOT product UI; NOT signed; NOT for distribution.

scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/renderer/fonts && cp renderer/index.html renderer/index.css dist/renderer/ && cp renderer/fonts/*.woff2 dist/renderer/fonts/
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:assets
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run lint:renderer-imports && npm run check:no-real-data && npm run test:ui-color
scripts.test: node --test tests/main.test.mjs tests/smoke.electron.test.mjs tests/ipc-handlers.unit.test.mjs tests/ipc-casebox-handlers.unit.test.mjs tests/ipc-fact-handlers.unit.test.mjs tests/ipc-list-projection.unit.test.mjs tests/ipc-get-document-projection.unit.test.mjs tests/dto-contract.test.mjs tests/check-renderer-imports.test.mjs tests/check-no-real-data.test.mjs tests/renderer-router.test.mjs tests/renderer-dto-sync.test.mjs tests/renderer-no-hardcoded-color.test.mjs tests/renderer-api.test.mjs tests/renderer-dom.test.mjs tests/renderer-list-matters.test.mjs tests/renderer-create-matter.test.mjs tests/renderer-view-matter.test.mjs tests/renderer-archive-matter.test.mjs tests/renderer-format-ledger.test.mjs tests/renderer-deadline-urgency.test.mjs tests/renderer-deadline-write.test.mjs tests/renderer-fact-write.test.mjs tests/renderer-fact-review.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test tests/main.test.mjs tests/ipc-handlers.unit.test.mjs tests/ipc-casebox-handlers.unit.test.mjs tests/dto-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:ipc-unit: npm run build && node --test tests/ipc-handlers.unit.test.mjs tests/ipc-casebox-handlers.unit.test.mjs
scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix ../../docs/contracts/case-box-contract run build && npm --prefix ../../services/case-box-persistence run build && npm run pack:internal && npm install
